answers.rationale: SR3 specifies a trie with literal/parameter/wildcard segments, O(path-length) lookup, no per-request allocation beyond the parameter map.

presented_options.D: a HEAD request reuses the GET handler and omits the body from the response

answers.rationale: FR3 requires explicit method dispatch and HEAD-fallback-to-GET and OPTIONS auto-listing allowed methods. Auto-registering POST when GET is registered is not in the spec and is inconsistent with explicit method dispatch.

presented_options.A: waits indefinitely until every in-flight request completes, then exits with code 0
